name: Settlement Reporting Response V 04
definition: The SettlementReportingResponse message is sent by any party (acquirer, agent or issuer) to an agent in response to a SettlementReportingInitiation message.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Information related to the management of the protocol.

SettlementInstitution.name: Settlement Institution
SettlementInstitution.definition: financial institution (or its agent) at which the accounts are held by the parties settling. This institution, acting on information provided by the parties, transfers the appropriate funds between the accounts.

FinancialInstitution.name: Financial Institution
FinancialInstitution.definition: Financial Institution to which the settlement totals apply.

OtherInstitution.name: Other Institution
OtherInstitution.definition: Additional institution involved in settlement. For example, the other party involved in bilateral settlement agreement.

Programme.name: Programme
Programme.definition: Programme, network, or brand processes the transaction.

SystemTraceAuditNumber.name: System Trace Audit Number
SystemTraceAuditNumber.definition: Number assigned by a transaction originator to assist in identifying a transaction uniquely. The trace number remains unchanged for all messages within a two-message exchange (for example, request/repeat and response)

TransmissionDateTime.name: Transmission Date Time
TransmissionDateTime.definition: Date and time expressed in UTC of the message as sent by the initiator.

RetrievalReferenceNumber.name: Retrieval Reference Number
RetrievalReferenceNumber.definition: A reference supplied by the system retaining the original source information and used to assist in locating that information or a copy thereof.

Jurisdiction.name: Jurisdiction
Jurisdiction.definition: Contains information that identifies or is specific to a transaction jurisdiction.

SettlementService.name: Settlement Service
SettlementService.definition: Type of settlement service for specific services requiring settlement.

AdditionalFee.name: Additional Fee
AdditionalFee.definition: Fees not included in the transaction amount.

Reconciliation.name: Reconciliation
Reconciliation.definition: Identification of the reconciliation period between the acquirer and the issuer or their respective agents.

TransactionDescription.name: Transaction Description
TransactionDescription.definition: Transaction data related to programmes and services, content and format based on bilateral agreements.

ProcessingResult.name: Processing Result
ProcessingResult.definition: Processing results of the settlement service.

ProtectedData.name: Protected Data
ProtectedData.definition: Contains protected data and the attributes used to protect the data.

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.

SecurityTrailer.name: Security Trailer
SecurityTrailer.definition: Trailer of the message containing a MAC.
